label: Avoid non-essential transits (NAVCENT)
name: Strait of Hormuz
note: On 28 Oct US NAVCENT advised ships without business in Hormuz/Gulf of Oman to stay well clear and warned neutral vessels may be boarded under the US blockade of Iran; flows are near pre-war levels but Iranian attacks on ships hit a wartime high of ~30 in October (Insurance Journal/Bloomberg).
